experiments.name: vanilla
experiments.hypothesis: Binary outcome reward and A/L expose group saturation and length dilution.

experiments.name: turn_discount
experiments.hypothesis: Earlier turns retain more credit and late-stage guessing is suppressed.

experiments.name: prm_lite
experiments.hypothesis: Dense rule rewards reduce all-zero/all-one groups but may be diluted by A/L.

experiments.name: lata
experiments.hypothesis: A/sqrt(L) preserves learning signal for long reasoning turns.

experiments.name: joint
experiments.hypothesis: PRM-Lite supplies local signal and LATA transmits it without linear dilution.

execution_note: The pure reward and credit-assignment kernels are tested. A paper-comparable training matrix requires unrestricted multi-turn trajectories; the current four-way one-token run cannot validate LATA.
